judgments.reason: Scientific Data descriptor by the same authors, with the same title as the dataset. It describes the MEG plus STN LFP recordings in Parkinson's patients at rest and in two motor tasks.
judgments.paper_title: Exploring the electrophysiology of Parkinson’s disease with magnetoencephalography and deep brain recordings

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: MEG-BIDS is the BIDS extension specification for MEG data, a standard the dataset follows, not a paper describing this Parkinson's MEG-STN dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
